answer: In this EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. Freshly spawned sybil accounts begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted, reciprocal interactions, transitivity cannot bootstrap them into credible peers, and they cannot pass consensus. A hollow cluster may echo endorsements like zephyr through cedar branches, but decay and trust-weighted links prevent volume alone from creating authority.
